labuan-square.name: Labuan Square and Merdeka Walk
labuan-square.hours: Open all day; best in daylight
labuan-square.tip: Start here for orientation and the colonial-era buildings around the padang.

financial-park.name: Financial Park and Ujana Kewangan
financial-park.hours: Grounds open all day; shops roughly 10:00–22:00, check on the day
financial-park.tip: The seafront promenade here is an easy evening stroll with food stalls nearby.

world-war-ii-memorial.name: Labuan World War II Memorial
world-war-ii-memorial.tip: A quiet, well-kept cemetery and memorial; allow time to read the plaques.

chimney.name: The Chimney (Tanjung Kubong)
chimney.price_text: Small entry fee may apply; check on the day
chimney.hours: Daylight hours; check on the day
chimney.tip: A short walk through forest leads to the old brick chimney; bring water and insect repellent.

peace-park.name: Labuan Peace Park
peace-park.tip: Combines well with the Chimney on the same northern loop; go early for cooler air.

surrender-point.name: Surrender Point
surrender-point.tip: Marks where Japanese forces in Borneo surrendered; pair with the Peace Park next door.

botanical-garden.name: Labuan Botanical Garden
botanical-garden.tip: Shady paths near town; good for a short walk between sights.

bird-park.name: Labuan Bird Park
bird-park.price_text: Small entry fee; check on the day
bird-park.tip: Walk-through aviaries suit families; go in the morning when birds are active.

central-market.name: Labuan Central Market
central-market.hours: Early morning to afternoon; busiest mornings
central-market.tip: Come early for fresh fish and local snacks; bring small notes.

seafood-dinner.name: Seafood dinner by the waterfront
seafood-dinner.price_text: Mid-range; price depends on catch, ask before ordering
seafood-dinner.hours: Evening, roughly 17:00–22:00, check on the day
seafood-dinner.tip: Ask for the price per weight before you order fish or prawns.

duty-free-shops.name: Duty-free shopping in town
duty-free-shops.price_text: Free to browse; alcohol and chocolate are the usual buys
duty-free-shops.hours: Shops roughly 10:00–21:00, check on the day
duty-free-shops.tip: Labuan is a duty-free island; compare prices and check customs limits for your onward flight or ferry.

island-hopping.name: Island-hopping boat trip
island-hopping.price_text: Book at the jetty; price varies by boat and islands, confirm before paying
island-hopping.tip: Agree the route, price and return time in writing before boarding.

ferry-terminal.name: Labuan Ferry Terminal
ferry-terminal.price_text: Ferry fares vary by destination; buy at the counter
ferry-terminal.hours: Early morning to evening sailings; check schedules on the day
ferry-terminal.tip: Arrive well before departure and keep your passport handy for Brunei and Sabah routes.

beach-walk.name: Beach walk on the north coast
beach-walk.tip: Quiet sand and shallow water; bring sun protection and take your rubbish away.

sunset-viewpoint.name: Sunset viewpoint over the bay
sunset-viewpoint.tip: Find a spot along the seafront early; sunsets here are quick and colourful.

heritage-walk.name: Old town heritage walk
heritage-walk.tip: Walk between the square, memorial and waterfront to see the island's colonial and wartime history in a couple of hours.

local-coffee.name: Local coffee and kueh stop
local-coffee.price_text: Cheap; a few ringgit per item
local-coffee.hours: Morning to afternoon, check on the day
local-coffee.tip: Try local snacks with coffee; many shops close by late afternoon.

sport-fishing.name: Sport fishing charter
sport-fishing.price_text: Charter price per boat; confirm inclusions
sport-fishing.hours: Half or full day; weather dependent
sport-fishing.tip: Ask what gear, bait and drinks are included and whether the boat has shade.

night-market.name: Evening food stalls
night-market.hours: Evening, roughly 17:00–22:00, check on the day
night-market.tip: Busiest on weekend evenings; bring cash and small notes.

war-museum.name: Small wartime history displays
war-museum.price_text: Entry fee may apply; check on the day
war-museum.tip: Displays are modest; combine with the memorial and Peace Park for the full story.

scooter-rental.name: Scooter or car rental for the island loop
scooter-rental.price_text: Daily rate varies by vehicle; check licence and insurance
scooter-rental.hours: Rental offices daytime; check on the day
scooter-rental.tip: A half-day loop reaches the north-coast sights; bring a licence and check fuel policy.
